senses.gloss: Asia Minor, or rather the Roman province embracing the Western part of the peninsula of Asia Minor, bequeathed by King Attalus to the Roman republic.

R. s. 44</cite> (once for <cite ref="S01566"><he>קני</he></cite>, once for <he>קניזי</he>, some ed. <cite ref="A02678"><he>אפייה</he></cite> corr. acc.).
